summary: Completed backend testing of Centro de Control WhatsApp Notifications (Twilio). All 16 tests passed. Twilio is correctly configured (twilio_configured: true) with credentials from .env. WhatsApp sending is disabled because ALERT_WHATSAPP_TO is empty (configured: false) - this is expected behavior as noted in requirements.
action_items: LOW: To enable WhatsApp notifications, add recipient phone numbers to ALERT_WHATSAPP_TO in backend/.env (comma-separated, E.164 format: +521234567890)
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsApp notification service correctly implemented using Twilio SDK with async sending via ThreadPoolExecutor
Twilio credentials properly loaded from environment variables (TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM)
All WhatsApp endpoints properly protected with authentication (get_current_user dependency)
WhatsApp config endpoint correctly distinguishes between twilio_configured (credentials set) and configured (recipients set)
Error handling is comprehensive - returns detailed status including sandbox_note for Twilio sandbox users
Alert message generation includes proper formatting with emojis, severity indicators, and truncation for long messages
Integration with Centro de Control alerts system - automatically sends WhatsApp for critical alerts when configured
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp notification system (Twilio) fully tested. Key findings: 1) Twilio credentials are correctly configured (twilio_configured: true). 2) WhatsApp is enabled (WHATSAPP_ENABLED=true). 3) No recipients configured (ALERT_WHATSAPP_TO is empty), so configured=false. 4) All endpoints protected with authentication. 5) GET /whatsapp/config returns detailed status. 6) GET /notificaciones/config shows all 3 channels: email, whatsapp, websocket. 7) To enable WhatsApp sending, add phone numbers to ALERT_WHATSAPP_TO in .env.

GET_centro_control_ping.details: Returns status:ok, service name, version, timestamp. No auth required.

GET_centro_control_whatsapp_config.details: Returns twilio_configured:true, enabled:true, configured:false, from_number:+14155238886, recipients_count:0. Requires auth.

POST_centro_control_whatsapp_test.details: Returns success:false with message 'WhatsApp no configurado' because no recipients. Requires auth.

POST_centro_control_whatsapp_alerta_crit.details: Returns success:false because no recipients configured. Requires auth.

GET_centro_control_notificaciones_config.details: Returns all 3 notification services: email (configured:true), whatsapp (twilio_configured:true, configured:false), websocket (enabled:true). Requires auth.

Authentication_protection.details: All WhatsApp endpoints correctly return 401/403 without authentication. Only /ping is public.

twilio_configuration_verification.recommendation: Add recipient phone numbers to ALERT_WHATSAPP_TO to enable WhatsApp notifications

mocked_integrations.note: No mocked integrations - real Twilio SDK is used but no messages sent because no recipients configured
